build_DeformConv_module: build a DeformConv module with configurable in/out channels, kernel size, stride, padding, dilation, and deformable groups
build_ModulatedDeformConv_module: build a ModulatedDeformConv module with optional bias, normalization, and activation for modulated deformable convolution
run_deform_conv_function: run the deform_conv autograd function with input, offset, weight, stride, padding, dilation, groups, and deformable groups
run_modulated_deform_conv_function: run the modulated_deform_conv autograd function with input, offset, mask, weight, bias, stride, padding, and dilation
review_DeformConv_backward: review the _DeformConv backward pass that computes gradients for input, offset, and weight via CUDA C extensions
